title: Time to cut coupons and save some money
author: IntelligentClient552
selftext:
No not really but holy moly folks if you are paying anything near what I have in the past few months you could probably use a decent savings by now!  I started using DeepSeek -v4-Pro and it performs on par with Opus for sure.  Now if you use it via ollama it's still fairly pricey but if you go to [https://platform.deepseek.com/](https://platform.deepseek.com/) and grab an API key you can have the system set itself up in a few minutes and it is soooooooooooo cheap, this is a real screenshot, not edited and these are real numbers.  


Worst case have DeepSeek write the bulk of the game for $0.25 and pay Fable to polish it, you will still save thousands of dollars!

PS : DeepSeek is not image today, next version is but for right now I use a local gemma as a tool in claude code to grant vision to DeepSeek, extra step but works perfectly.
